name: robots/barisyazici__libfranka-sim
title: Franka Hand (libfranka-sim)
intro: Franka Hand (libfranka-sim), adapted from barisyazici/libfranka-sim. It reads `width_mm`, `max_width_mm`, `is_grasped`, `is_stuck` and 1 more; runs `grasp`, `release`, `hand_home`, `hand_move` and 1 more. `grasp`: close the gripper on a target object with a bounded force and report the achieved grasp width. A failed grasp is a completed operation with grasped=false, not a silent success. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
